one_line: Yadava ruler of Devagiri navigating tribute, conquest, and shifting loyalties during Alauddin Khalji’s campaigns.

appearance.age_look: late 40s, medium height, sturdy build with the calm bearing of an experienced courtly ruler
appearance.face: oval face, light-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache with a short beard along the jawline, sharp thoughtful eyes with a default composed, slightly weary expression
appearance.hair: black hair pulled back under a soft conical cloth turban (pheta) in muted saffron with a maroon band, a small gold jewel at the front, a few short side-locks visible before the ears
appearance.costume: a long-sleeved knee-length cotton angarakha robe in deep maroon with subtle woven geometric borders in dull gold, tied to the right; beneath, a cream-colored tunic collar peeks out; he wears a wide mustard-yellow cloth sash at the waist, off-white cotton churidar-style fitted trousers, and dark brown leather sandals; over one shoulder, a pale green cotton shawl with thin maroon edging hangs diagonally like a light rajyashri mantle; simple but dignified gold ornaments: a thin gold necklace with a small circular pendant, modest gold stud earrings, and a single plain gold ring on the right hand
appearance.signature: a sheathed straight-backed steel sword with a simple South Indian-style hilt and rounded pommel, suspended from a brown leather belt at his left hip, the wooden scabbard lacquered in dark red with two thin brass bands near the throat

ref_desc: Ramachandra Deva is a late-40s Yadava ruler with a maroon angarakha, saffron turban, pale green shawl, cream churidar trousers, simple gold ornaments, and a dark red sheathed straight-backed sword, in a maroon, mustard, cream, pale green, and dark brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Ramachandra Deva: a late-40s Yadava ruler of medium height and sturdy build, with an oval light-brown Deccan face, straight nose, short black moustache and jawline beard, and thoughtful eyes in a composed, slightly weary expression. His black hair is mostly hidden under a soft conical cloth turban (pheta) in muted saffron with a maroon band and a small gold jewel at the front, with short side-locks visible before the ears. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length cotton angarakha robe in deep maroon with subtle woven geometric borders in dull gold, fastening to the right, over a cream-colored tunic whose collar just peeks out. Around his waist is a wide mustard-yellow cloth sash, with off-white cotton churidar-style fitted trousers and dark brown leather sandals completing the outfit. A pale green cotton shawl with thin maroon edging drapes from one shoulder diagonally across his torso like a light mantle. He has modest gold ornaments: a thin gold necklace with a small circular pendant, simple gold stud earrings, and a single plain gold ring on his right hand. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon, a sheathed straight-backed steel sword with a simple South Indian-style hilt and rounded pommel, in a dark red lacquered wooden scabbard with two thin brass bands near the throat, suspended from a brown leather belt. Show him from head to toe with clear views of his face, turban, layered garments, shawl, ornaments, and sword, using maroon, mustard yellow, cream, pale green, and dark brown as dominant colors.
